prompts.text:
The person in [Image 1] turns into a cheerful Christmas elf and dances. Keep the person exactly as photographed: copy the exact face and hair from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), so their friends recognize them at once. The face stays the same from the first frame to the last, also while they laugh and spin.

Within the first second their clothes change into an elf outfit with a small burst of gold sparkles: a red and green tunic with gold buttons and a wide belt, red-and-white striped stockings, curled pointy shoes, pointy elf ears and a tall pointed elf hat with a small bell. A warm living room with a lit Christmas tree, string lights and wrapped presents.

0-1 s: the person stands by the tree in the clothes from [Image 1], smiles into the camera, and the sparkles turn the clothes into the elf outfit.
1-8 s: they do a bouncy elf dance: hopping side to side, kicking their heels, swinging their arms and spinning, laughing at the camera.
8-10 s: the camera moves in to a medium shot from the knees up: the elf flicks the bell on the hat and gives a big grin and a wink into the camera.

Full body in frame while dancing, filmed close enough that the face stays clear and big. One continuous shot, vertical 9:16, photorealistic, like a real home video on Christmas Eve.
Jingling sleigh bells and a bouncy festive beat in the audio, no vocals, no lyrics, no talking.
Real people with real bodies and real faces, live action: never a cut-out photo head on a cartoon body, never a paper doll, never a puppet or a cartoon. One head on each body, five fingers on each hand. Everyone is a grown adult from the photo: no child, no extra person. No text, no captions, no logos, no brand names, no famous characters, no watermark.

prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. 9:16 vertical photo, like a real phone photo at home on Christmas Eve, taken at the height of the pet. The tree stands behind the pet, a little to one side, its lights soft and warm. The pet wears a tall pointed elf hat, green with a red band, with a small gold bell on the tip, and a little red-and-green elf collar with gold buttons around its neck. It faces the camera with a happy face. Its whole body is in view, from the ears to the paws, with its tail. Soft warm light, natural fur detail, a little phone-camera softness. 3-6 s: it spins in a happy circle, then does a little bounce with its front paws off the floor.
6-8 s: it wiggles and wags its tail, the bell jingling.
8-10 s: it trots up to the camera and tilts its head, looking straight into the lens.
Jingling sleigh bells and a bouncy festive beat in the audio, no vocals, no lyrics, no talking. The pet never speaks.
